title: alpha_score_market_regime paper sleeve: same-signal-day idempotency + report renders true pending queue
trigger: Operator found CAT listed as rank-1 pending buy in data/paper_sleeves/alpha_score_market_regime/state.json but ABSENT from data/daily/reports/report_20260630.txt; the two disagreed.

root_cause.double_run: The daily pipeline processed the 2026-06-30 close signal twice (snapshots generated_at 2026-07-01T03:43:40Z and 2026-07-01T05:06:12Z, both asof_date=2026-06-30; identical universe 57 tickers / 53 ranked / identical alpha scores).
root_cause.bug_a_non_idempotent_admission: build_alpha_score_market_regime_paper_sleeve_snapshot computed capacity = min(room, daily_entry_slots) without subtracting pending entries already created for the same as_of. Run 1 captured CAT (rank 1) into pending_entries; run 2 excluded CAT via already_pending_in_paper_sleeve and then granted a FRESH daily slot to the next-ranked candidate GEV. Result: 2 pending entries (CAT+GEV) for one signal day although daily_entry_slots=1.
root_cause.bug_b_report_shows_new_candidates_not_pe: report_generator.generate_daily_report rendered alpha_score_market_regime_paper_sleeve['candidates'] (new-this-run shortlist). On run 2 CAT was excluded from that shortlist (already pending), so a real pending paper buy vanished from the operator-facing report while remaining in state.json pending_entries.

disproven_hypothesis.data_timing_backfill: Considered that CAT's score was backfilled late (would make CAT a spurious signal). DISPROVEN: both same-day runs had identical universe size (57/53) and byte-identical alpha scores for GEV/DE/AMD/INTC; CAT ranked #1 stably at alpha_score=0.712875 in the first run. CAT is a legitimate rank-1 candidate; the defect is purely idempotency + reporting, not signal validity.

fix.quant/alpha_score_market_regime_paper_sl: Subtract pending_for_asof (pending entries whose created_asof == as_of_date) from daily_entry_slots when computing capacity, making same-signal-day re-runs idempotent (pending capped at daily_entry_slots per signal day).
fix.quant/report_generator.py: Render an explicit 'Pending queue (next-open paper buys)' block from alpha_score_market_regime_paper_sleeve['pending_entries'] so an entry captured by an earlier same-day run stays visible; report and state.json pending can no longer disagree.

test: quant/test_alpha_score_market_regime_paper_sleeve.py::test_same_signal_day_rerun_is_idempotent_and_does_not_double_admit — two-strong-candidate universe (WIN rank1, WIN2 rank2, top_decile=2); run 1 admits only WIN; re-run keeps WIN2 as a valid candidate but the daily-slot guard rejects it (daily_top1_or_capacity_limit), pending stays [WIN].
production_impact: None on live orders. Sleeve is trade_enabled=False, paper-only, alters_orders=False. Change affects paper-sleeve state hygiene and operator report fidelity only; no live buy/sell/rank/size/heat/LLM path touched.
residual_state_note: The already-corrupted live state (CAT+GEV both pending for 2026-06-30) is NOT retroactively edited by this repair to avoid racing the scheduled auto-committer; the fix prevents recurrence. Cleaning the stale extra GEV pending is an optional follow-up.
